fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the compound wall of the complainant near Nallur Colony College Road was defaced and partly broken. The matter was brought to Madurai North PS on 2025-05-14, while the incident was placed on 2025-05-14 around 22:10 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Uma Raj (9000000089). The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, college road, CCTV, night, photograph
